description: This file is a Java interface defining user-related services in the sales manager application. It declares methods for retrieving users, creating or updating users, and listing users by store, extending a base service interface.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Java interface for user-related business logic services, extending a generic entity service interface.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a User object by username, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all users, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a User object, may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of users associated with a specific merchant store, may throw a ServiceException.
